title: 第11章 你能不能别叫我狗第12章 杀人扣礼物一半的钱
slug: 穿成女配弹幕让我又争又抢
content_zh:
云茵回头瞪了他一眼，“不准跟着我！”
沈宴听话，停在了原地。
【性感母蟑螂：送出玫瑰花x66。】
【建材美妇王阿姨：送出啤酒x20。】
【姐独自美丽：哈哈，我们的办法可行吧，女主估计正拉肚子呢。】
季月止不住的点头，折磨主角爽哉，收到礼物更是爽哉爽哉。
突然，她冒出一个疑问，云茵和沈宴设计挖她灵根时，梁子就算是结下了，她想要报仇，而做出针对女主的事，不就和原剧情走向是一样的吗？
如果她改变不了剧情走向，不能让观众感到爽，不能打出‘大女主’的主题，她的结局就是被女主和女主的后宫们挫骨扬灰。
季月心情烦躁，果然这钱还是不好赚，她不知不觉回了弟子院。
沈宴发丝微乱，说话气息不稳的道：“月月。”
真是难为他了，时间管理大师。
季月没心情陪他演戏，将两本功法丢给他，道：“乖狗狗，自己玩去。”
“……”，沈宴觉得很屈辱。
他想反驳，又怕惹季月不高兴，到时不知要等多少天才消气，不给他送资源，云茵可等不及。
月华院。
袁松亭坐在门槛上，嘴好干，喉咙好疼，好想喝水。
好不容易等到季月回来，他殷勤的站起身，口中发出难听的粗粝嗓音：“季师姐，我已经将月华院里里外外都打扫干净了。”
季月瞥了眼屋子，对袁松亭道：“袁师弟辛苦了，你先回去吧。”
袁松亭回去喝了好几壶水方才缓解不适，心底对季月讨厌上了，都是同门师姐弟，她给点钱他赚怎么了？
干活不准停就算了，还不给水喝，哪怕是人牙子手中的奴隶也不会如此苛待！

翌日，天刚微亮。
沈宴送早点到月华院，季月打着哈欠接过来，“乖狗狗。”
“……”
三个字从长相姣好的季月口中吐出，虽无旁人在场，沈宴听到还是会觉得难堪。
他有些小小的生气：“你能不能别叫我狗？”
季月嘁了一声：“矫情，是你自己同意给我当狗的，我又没逼你。”
沈宴回想一下还真是。
季月见他还不走，催促道：“赶紧爬。”
沈宴默默走出月华院，却没走远，他听有个师弟说，季月最近与一个男子勾勾搭搭，这两天还亲自送早膳。
曾经几时季月也天天给他送吃食。
之前他以为季月让他天不亮起来买早点，是故意让他想起那段过往，没想到居然是借花献佛给其他野男人吃。
季月将糕点摆好盘就装进食篮中，提着就出门了，根本没发现后面还跟着人。
沈宴尾随季月一路，最后见季月进去了尊主殿，怔愣了几秒。
殿内。
季月一脸期待的望着如冷霜般的祝徵，“师尊，我新做的桃花酥，尝尝？”
祝徵眸子微动，修长的手指捻起一块卖相很好的糕点咬了一口。
content_en:
Yun Yin turned back and glared at him, "Don't follow me!"
Shen Yan obeyed and stopped where he was.
[Sexy Female Cockroach: Give out 66 roses. 】
[Auntie Wang, the beautiful building materials woman: Give away 20 beers. 】
[Sister Alone and Beautiful: Haha, our method may work. The heroine is probably suffering from diarrhea. 】
Ji Yue couldn't help but nod. It was so satisfying to torture the protagonist, and it was even more satisfying to receive the gift.
Suddenly, she had a question. When Yun Yin and Shen Yan planned to dig up her spiritual roots, even if Liang Zi was connected, if she wanted revenge and did something against the heroine, wouldn't it be the same as the original plot?
If she cannot change the direction of the plot, make the audience feel happy, and achieve the theme of 'big heroine', her ending will be to be crushed by the heroine and her harem.
Ji Yue was in a irritable mood. As expected, it was still difficult to make money, so she returned to the disciples' courtyard without knowing it.
Shen Yan's hair was slightly messy and he spoke unsteadily: "Yueyue."
It’s really hard for him, a master of time management.
Ji Yue was not in the mood to act with him, so she threw the two exercises to him and said, "Good boy, go play by yourself."
"..." Shen Yan felt very humiliated.
He wanted to refute, but he was afraid of making Ji Yue unhappy. He didn't know how many days it would take to calm down. Yun Yin couldn't wait if he didn't send him resources.
Yuehuayuan.
Yuan Songting was sitting on the threshold. His mouth was so dry, his throat hurt, and he really wanted to drink water.
After finally waiting for Ji Yue to come back, he stood up diligently and said in an unpleasant rough voice: "Senior Sister Ji, I have cleaned the inside and outside of Yuehua Courtyard."
Ji Yue glanced at the room and said to Yuan Songting: "Junior Brother Yuan, thank you for your hard work. You should go back first."
Yuan Songting went back and drank several bottles of water to relieve his discomfort. He hated Ji Yue in his heart. They were both brothers and sisters in the same school. What happened to him making money if she gave him some money?
Even if you are not allowed to stop working, and you are not given water to drink, even a slave in the hands of Ren Yazi will not treat you so harshly!
The next day, it was just dawn.
Shen Yan delivered breakfast to Yuehua Courtyard, Ji Yue yawned and took it, "Good little dog."
"..."
These three words came out of the good-looking Ji Yue's mouth. Although no one else was present, Shen Yan still felt embarrassed when he heard them.
He was a little angry: "Can you stop calling me a dog?"
Ji Yue snorted: "Hypocritical, you agreed to be my dog, and I didn't force you."
When Shen Yan thought about it, it was true.
Seeing that he was still not leaving, Ji Yue urged: "Hurry and crawl."
Shen Yan silently walked out of Yuehua Courtyard, but did not go far. He heard from a junior brother that Ji Yue had been hooking up with a man recently and had personally delivered breakfast in the past two days.
There was a time when Ji Yue brought him food every day.
Before, he thought that Ji Yue asked him to get up before dawn to buy breakfast, deliberately reminding him of that past, but he didn't expect that Ji Yue actually borrowed flowers to offer to other wild men.
Ji Yue put the cakes on the plate and put them in the basket, carried them out and went out without realizing that there was anyone following behind.
Shen Yan followed Ji Yue all the way, and was stunned for a few seconds when he finally saw Ji Yue entering the Lord's Hall.
Inside the palace.
Ji Yue looked at Zhu Zheng who was as cold as frost with an expectant look on her face, "Master, please try my newly made peach blossom cake?"
Zhu Zheng's eyes moved slightly, and he picked up a piece of good-looking pastry with his long fingers and took a bite.
